label: Individuating non-present candidates: the axiarchic rival and the cognition criterion (#2145 lane C)
summary: See docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md, section 'Individuating non-present candidates: the axiarchic rival and the cognition criterion'. Follows attempt e03ee9b6 (Lane 4), which recorded the cognition criterion 3b40009e as a direct assumption at parity with the axiarchic rival. Question: to favour x over y by value before either exists, where are x and y individuated? Verified result 1895c9f3 (goodGeneralFavouringIsApprehensionOfIndividuation, zero-axiom main theorem) derives 3b40009e from excluded middle ee4ab504, item realization 633d5c29 (a favouring profile is the inverse image of a relation among the bearer's stand-in items), irreflexivity 3ca01752, the own-favouring bridge 65805e5a (no independent stand-in for a non-present candidate), the source-of-differences bridge 69b9f887 (no merely produced stand-in) and the containment-recognition bridge d1fb6414 (a contained stand-in that individuates a non-present candidate in a value-dependent favouring is a content about it that the bearer apprehends). Lean-only unindividuatedNotFavoured: realized irreflexive favouring never favours one of two candidates sharing a stand-in over the other (the nowhere horn). Comparator companion axiarchicControls on Lane 4's carrier: personal row with every premise; one row per failing premise (contained unapprehended stand-ins; independent realm; produced realm; one undifferentiated item, where no item relation realizes the favouring; a formally good-general non-contrastive favouring that favours an outcome over itself). Findings: the rival's positive accounts are creative requiredness (independent realm), aligned powers (contained; law 3 makes value-dependence a coincidence of two orders over the whole candidate space, the D-nature's alignment price generalized), and imitability exemplars (contained; value and favouring share the source's nature as ground; the divine-ideas structure without understanding, the #1892 objective-eminence status). Horn 1 does not conflict with (b) as encoded (ActualRoot concerns concrete grounds only); it conflicts with an inclusive sole-foundation reading, and its price (plural or value-first ultimacy) falls equally on a demiurge. The produced realm reduces to source containment by the source-of-differences demand, or (Plotinian) to a producer with no contrastive favouring, i.e. the final-cause-as-object rival of 980e6482. Horn 2 meets every typed property of Apprehends and About; the separating property is intentional versus virtual containment, untyped. Natural-case search (selection, homeostasis, etiological function, prices, least action, reinforcement learners): each favouring factors through a proxy that demonstrably diverges from value; no case passes; none counted as independent evidence. Symmetry: the same trilemma for the personal account, with matching occupants and prices horn by horn; individuation price shared (#1879); alignment is avoided on both sides only by grounding value in the source, after which ideas and imitability modes differ only in being understood. Rejected approaches: encoding a free requiredness or efficacy predicate (a flag, not a formalization); using 'relations of reason exist only in an intellect' against the imitability rival (definitional, question-begging); counting the absence of a natural case as evidence. Unreviewed: the independent semantic challenge is pending.
blocker: Not blocked. The residual dispute is the containment-recognition bridge d1fb6414 at the intentional/virtual containment boundary: whether a plurality of value-ranked modes of imitability in one simple nature, guiding its favouring, can be mind-independent without being real composition or real relations to non-existents (the #1892 objective-eminence status). Next tests: encode IntrinsicExemplarEminence with a favouring realized on contained modes and ConstitutivelySimple; a root-restricted recognition bridge with simplicity as a premise; aligned powers versus the D-nature as a configuration; check whether the Plotinian produced-realm structure is exactly the final cause as object.

current_assessment.scope: Individuation of non-present candidates for a value-responsive source; the cognition criterion and the axiarchic rival under one standard
current_assessment.assessment: The cognition criterion keeps its direct-assumption option and gains a registered conditional derivation (1895c9f3). Its recorded rationale that value must be present to the source in some non-causal way is now derived as containment of an individuating stand-in, from item realization, irreflexivity and two locus bridges; the step that such presence is intentional remains a direct assumption, narrowed to contained, individuating, value-guiding stand-ins (d1fb6414). Leslie-type creative requiredness denies the own-favouring bridge and pays, at a root, not being the sole ultimate at the inclusive scope; aligned powers pay a necessary alignment of two whole orders; noncognitive imitability exemplarism denies only recognition and stands at parity (the #1892 objective-eminence gap). The individuation price under simplicity is shared, and both sides avoid alignment only by grounding value in the source. Modest positive change in the criterion's support; no premise discharged, no unconditional ranking.
current_assessment.next_test: Can a mind-independent plurality of value-ranked modes in one simple nature be distinguished from real composition by anything typed (IntrinsicExemplarEminence with ConstitutivelySimple)? A root-restricted recognition bridge with simplicity; aligned powers versus the D-nature as a configuration; the Plotinian produced realm against the final cause as object.
